resources.string: Realistic starry sky aligned with your location and time, clearer in panoramas.
Smaller app: planetary maps download on demand and remain available offline; Io and Europa in 2K WebP.
Consistent weather in the main view and panoramas, with a saved visibility toggle.
Compact + and − in object details; the initial size is the minimum zoom.
Refined settings, units and scenarios, consistent controls and the Info & credits page.
Saved camera zoom and brief confirmation when object data refresh finishes.
